fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 38% match is a WEAK FIT for this Senior Customer Enablement Manager role at Figma.

**Strengths:**
- Raised Year 11 grade 5+ share from 71% to 86%
- Trained 12 colleagues, showing real training delivery experience
- Curriculum design and workshop facilitation, plus Notion and Google Workspace

**Gaps:**
- No 4+ years in SaaS customer success, enablement or account management
- No product adoption or customer enablement strategy experience
- No SaaS background or UX/UI, Design Ops or frontend experience

**Recommendation:** Build SaaS exposure first through a junior customer education or enablement role, then reapply to senior positions once you have a track record there.

Daniel Okafor

daniel.okafor@example.org

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Figma

Dear Hiring Manager,

Helping a team adopt something new is hard when each person arrives with different goals and a different level of confidence. As a physics teacher, I raised the share of Year 11 students reaching grade 5 or above from 71% to 86% over three years by adjusting how I explained things to each group. That is the same challenge behind your "adoption journey" for large, strategic customers.

I come from teaching, not SaaS, so I'll be plain about that. What I bring is training and enablement for adults, built on data. At Ashgrove Academy I wrote the Year 9 practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to use it. I also track progress in Excel and Google Sheets and present results to senior leadership each term, which is how I'd approach using product data to shape engagement strategies. I run weekly parent calls for a year group of 210 students, so I'm used to building trust with stakeholders who have very different expectations. I'm also building my analysis skills through the Google Data Analytics Certificate (in progress) and basic Python with pandas.

Figma's "Grow as you go" value fits how I work. I'd like to talk about how my approach to workshop facilitation and one-to-one coaching could support your London team, and I'm available for a conversation at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Customer Enablement Manager, Daniel Okafor
applicationEmail.body:
Hello Figma Hiring Team,

Helping people get real value from something complex is what I do as a physics teacher, including weekly parent calls for a year group of 210 students, each with different needs and goals. I've also written training that colleagues now use and presented progress data to senior leadership every term, so consultative, data-informed engagement is familiar ground. My CV and cover letter are attached for the full picture. I'm free for a call on weekday evenings after 5pm UK time.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor
